title: feat(spec,ui): a package's display name per locale — the translation bundle's packages group, read by Setup's package list and Studio's switcher
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoKGqRi6iRTCWFdbzGnhT2fC)_

Fixes #35513

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #37988

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：中文界面下，设置里的「软件包」列表（名称、详情标题、描述、搜索）和应用搭建左上角的软件包切换器，按软件包自己写的中文名显示；没写中文名的仍显示原来的英文名。
- 为什么做：属于「App Studio 改版」专题；HotCRM 的七个软件包在中文界面里都是英文名，和启动器里的中文应用名对不上，HotCRM 那边等这项才能补中文名。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是某个软件包仍显示英文名；软件包本身保存的名字不变，编辑对话框里看到和保存的仍是原名，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- **Spec — a new translation-bundle group `packages`** (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`), keyed by the package's `manifest.id`, each row `{ name?, description? }`. Precedent: `apps.APP_NAME.label` in the same bundle (seat ruling on this card's thread, claim 7217235557). It opens at every door the per-app shape reaches: bundle entry, platform bundle, served document, registered `translation` item.
  - The key is checked against the manifest id grammar, so a row keyed by a namespace (`crm`) or a display name is refused at parse with a sentence naming the rule, instead of never rendering.
  - `package` (singular) and the leaf spellings `label`, `title`, `displayName` are answered with the declared spelling.
- **`MANIFEST_ID_PATTERN` moves to `kernel/address-grammar.ts`** beside `NAMESPACE_PATTERN`; `kernel/manifest.zod.ts` re-exports it. Importing it from the manifest module into the translation module was an import cycle (measured: the spec build failed with `Cannot access 'LocaleSchema' before initialization`). Same constant, same name, every import keeps working.
- **Console reads it client-side from the served translation document** (`GET /i18n/translations/LOCALE` already carries every per-app group):
  - `@object-ui/i18n`: `useObjectLabel()` gains `packageName(pkg)` and `packageDescription(pkg)`. They read `packages[MANIFEST_ID]` by direct property access across the language chain, ⛔ not through a dot-separated `t()` key, because a manifest id carries dots. `SPEC_TRANSLATION_GROUPS` lists `packages`.
  - Setup › 软件包 (`PackagesPage.tsx`): row name, the installed-apps group row and its expand/collapse label, the detail sheet title and description, and search (matches the shown name and the manifest name).
  - Studio's package switcher (`StudioPackageSwitcher.tsx`): a package that ships no app (HotCRM revenue) is named by the translated package name; a package that publishes an app is still named by the app's label (ADR-0084 amendment item 2, unchanged).
- **Liveness ledger**: `translation/packages` seeded `live` with its readers in the same change (the `mappings` precedent).
- **Extractor and coverage** (`packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`, `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts`): the walker emits `packages.MANIFEST_ID.name` / `.description` for the stack's manifest and every composed package, so `os i18n extract` scaffolds them and `os i18n check` / `os lint` report a gap as `i18n/missing-package` (a warning, like every other missing translation). Required by `check:i18n-walk-parity`, which refused the declared group with no emitter; the parity fixture authors one member.
  - Consequence: a stack that declares a non-default locale and never named its package in it gets two new warnings per locale on upgrade. The changeset says so.
  - The four examples that declare `zh-CN` (and `ja-JP` for todo) now name their package there, so `check:i18n-coverage` stays at 577 baselined, none new.
- **Studio's translation preview** (`TranslationPreview.tsx`) draws a 软件包 / Packages card: its group table is held exhaustive against the schema by `satisfies`, so the new group failed the app-shell build without one.

### What hotcrm#2704 has to do (after this ships in a release HotCRM installs)

Until it does, `os lint` on HotCRM warns `i18n/missing-package` for each package and locale; `os i18n extract` scaffolds the rows.

In each HotCRM package's own translation files (`src/PACKAGE/translations/LOCALE.ts`), add one row keyed by that package's `manifest.id`, for example in `src/revenue/translations/zh-CN.ts`:

```ts
packages: { 'com.hotcrm.revenue': { name: '回款', description: '…' } },
```

Repeat for `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES` (and `en` only if the English display name should differ from `manifest.name`). Seven packages, one row each per locale. Nothing else changes in HotCRM: `manifest.name` stays as is.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-package.test.ts` (5): every door accepts the group; the dotted id stays one key; a non-id key is refused with the rule (`invalid_key`, message via `formatZodError`); unknown leaf refused; singular and leaf aliases answered.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/useObjectLabel-packageName-35513.test.tsx` (4): served zh-CN row names the package by its dotted id; misses fall back to `manifest.name` then the id; a bundle nesting the id by segment does not match; en without a bundle.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioPackageSwitcher.packageName-35513.test.ts` (3): app-less package takes the translated name; app-carrying package keeps the app label; default namer keeps `manifest.name`.
- `packages/runtime/src/package-display-name-disabled.test.ts` (2), the seat's pin: real `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin` + `AppPlugin` + host package-state store seeding the package disabled; `GET /i18n/translations/zh-CN` through `HttpDispatcher` serves `packages[id]` while `registry.getPackage(id).enabled === false`; control with the package enabled.
  - Ablation (on-disk, then restored): an early return in `AppPlugin.loadTranslations` for a disabled package turned the disabled case red (`1 failed | 1 passed`), control stayed green.
- Walker and coverage: `packages/lint` i18n-walk tests (22) and the reference/section suites (315) green; `packages/cli` i18n tests 51 files / 491 green after `test/i18n-multi-bundle-merge.test.ts` gained `packages` in its per-package family list. `test/package-union-readers.test.ts` (the two-package vs one-package pins) now names both packages in its zh-CN bundles, and its key totals differ by exactly the second package's name; the walker reads a manifest restated at the top level and in `packages[]` once. Full `@objectstack/cli` suite: 678 files / 8498 tests green locally.
- `TranslationPreview.categories-11765.test.tsx` gained a `packages` fixture row (keyed by a dotted manifest id); `adminPreviews.i18n-10862-s2.test.tsx` reads `2/19`; `useObjectLabel-identity-5564.test.tsx` counts 33 members (the two new resolvers). All green locally.
- Existing `ui/apps/console/src/loadLanguage.test.tsx` walks the served shape's groups, so it now covers `packages` alone (green: 2 files, 10 tests with the switcher file).

## Acceptance notes

- **Deviation from the claim's suggested route ("resolved on GET /packages the way translateApp does it")**: resolved client-side from the served translation document instead. `GET /packages` rows are what the edit dialog prefills from (`packageActions.tsx`: "Only the row's manifest is read"), so overlaying `manifest.name` in place on that read would save a translated name back as the authored one; a sibling computed field would widen the package list response contract as well. The client read has its own precedent (`useObjectLabel().appLabel` reads `apps.APP_NAME.label` from the same document). The L2 can still send this back.
- Studio's package overview page keeps the authored `manifest.name`: it is the authoring surface for that package, beside its editable fields.
- Setup's list is still sorted by `manifest.name` (the sort runs at fetch time); only what is drawn and searched is translated.
- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` does not yet teach the `packages` group; the claim's file surface excludes `skills/**`, so that is carded as #37988 (Skills-docs line above). The docs-drift bot also names `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` and `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx`, which list the bundle's groups: same follow-up.
- **File surface beyond the claim's list**, each forced by a gate or a build: `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`, `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts`, `packages/cli/test/i18n-multi-bundle-merge.test.ts` and `packages/cli/test/package-union-readers.test.ts` (walk parity and Test Core); `scripts/fixtures/i18n-walk-parity/every-group.stack.json` (the gate's own prescribed fixture); `examples/app-{crm,starter,showcase,todo}` translation bundles (coverage ratchet); `TranslationPreview.tsx`, the studio catalogue rows and three preview/identity tests (app-shell build and Test UI). No `skills/**`, `docs/adr/**` or hotcrm file is touched.
- `os validate` does not yet check a `packages.KEY` against the stack's known manifest ids (`translation-target-unknown`); the key grammar is checked at parse. A follow-up if the L2 wants it.

## Verification

Two-minute check: run the four test files above from the repo root (spec and runtime with `pnpm --filter PKG exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 FILE`, ui with `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run FILE`); expect 14 passed.

Read first, by risk: `ui/packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts` (`packageAttr`), `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` (the `packages` group), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx` (delete-confirm text now equals the shown, possibly translated, title).

<details><summary>Local gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran FILE` at head 9aea740e (58771103 adds only the walker's de-duplication and a cli test): **130 derived, 127 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**; every run family exit 0.

- NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite not met): `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (shallow clone), `@objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` (needs a client-react build; no `skills/**` touched), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs the full dual build). CI runs all three.
- `check:i18n-walk-parity` was red on the first push (the group had no emitter); fixed in b226ecfd and re-run green with `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:generated`, `check:liveness` and the changeset gates.
- Typecheck: spec, lint and cli exit 0. UI typecheck needs the ui dependency builds; NOT MEASURED locally, CI `Type Check UI` covers it (it caught the preview row, fixed in 9aea740e). One `Test UI (7/16)` run on 9aea740e failed a `ResourceListPage.listStateInUrl-36896` sort case this PR does not touch; it passes locally and passed on 58771103.

</details>
